_comment: Copy relevant sections into Claude Desktop / Cursor MCP config. All 3 servers are optional; add what you need.

tft-oracle._note: Static game data (champs, traits, items, augments). No API key needed.

tft-history._note: Post-match history via Riot API. Dev key expires in 24h; get a Personal Key for permanent access at developer.riotgames.com.

reverseiii._note: Our own server: exposes live state, patch meta, and recommend_move tool.
